verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Open Finance offers separate API products, such as account owner verification, balance, and transaction data. None of it documents product-scoped consent requests in Connect, granular data scopes, or data-minimization controls. Separate product endpoints are an adjacent feature, not scoped consent, so the evidence leaves this applicable story unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
